rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for physical or mental tiredness, especially in formal or written contexts.

example.english: After working for hours, they felt extreme exhaustion.
example.traditional: 長時間工作後，佢哋都感到極度疲勞。
example.jyutping: coeng4 si4 gaan3 gung1 zok3 hau6 keoi5 dei6 dou1 gam2 dou3 gik6 dou6 pei4 lou4

rows.note: Use this construction when a resource or supply has been completely used up; Cantonese normally states the result rather than naming the depleted state.

example.english: The batteries were drained to exhaustion, so the machine shut off.
example.traditional: 啲電用到冇晒，部機即刻熄咗。
example.jyutping: di1 din6 jung6 dou3 mou5 saai3 bou6 gei1 zik1 hak1 sik1 zo2
